source_documents.title: Deep-Red Fluorescent Organic Nanoparticles with High Brightness and Photo-Stability for Super-Resolution In Vitro and In Vivo Imaging Using STED Nanoscopy

reference_evidence_units.quote: when the solvent polarity was increased, large emission red- shift from 580 to 700 nm was observed
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-0C8, -2C8 and -4C8
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent series; main text referring to SI S16-S18.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The series shows polarity-dependent red shifts assigned to TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Range describes the series, not independently digitized target endpoints; SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: its PL intensity was clearly strengthened when much more water was added (fw> 60%)
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water series after initial polarity quenching.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target emission recovers at high water fraction, whereas -0C8 and -2C8 continue to quench.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Recovery is not proof that absolute yield exceeds pure THF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: when fw is 90%, it should be mentioned that DBTBT- 4C8 can easily precipitate
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8
reference_evidence_units.statement: Precipitation is reported to reduce brightness at 90% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Loss of emissive material in solution should not be mislabeled intrinsic ACQ.

reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1 visually inspected; THF and solid measurements.
reference_evidence_units.statement: THF/solid PLQYs are 25%/25%; solid lifetime 3.85 ns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Only the PLQY and lifetime are observations; derived rates separated below.

reference_evidence_units.quote: DBTBT-2C8 and DBTBT-4C8, whose backbones contain alkyl chains, had larger kr values compared with DBTBT-0C8.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-0C8, -2C8 and -4C8
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Rates derived from solid PLQY/lifetime, Table 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: For -4C8, kr=6.45e7 and knr=19.52e7 s-1; knr is lower than -2C8 (30.29e7), but not -0C8 (19.33e7).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The text's broad claim of decreased knr needs this comparator qualification; these are derived rates, not directly measured constants.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the motions of flexible chains are proposed can be well restricted by its lamellar packing.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Thin-film GISAXS described in main text; SI S22.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Lamellar packing is proposed to restrict flexible-chain motion and improve emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: GISAXS supports order/orientation, not direct dynamic immobilization; SI pattern not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: twisted molecular backbones were observed in DBTBT-2C8 and DBTBT-4C8
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-2C8 and -4C8
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors predict twisted backbones and suggest reduced quenching pi-stacking.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not an aggregate exciton calculation or direct structure of nanoparticle packing.

reference_evidence_units.quote: well-defined and mono-dispersed spherical nanoparticles with size (50+/-5 nm)
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8 in DSPE-PEG2000 FONPs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Nanoprecipitation; main methods p.27 use 1 mg dye and 1 mg polymer in 1 mL THF into 5 mL water.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target/polymer nanoparticles are approximately 50+/-5 nm by TEM and PDI 0.11 by DLS.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Nanoparticle morphology is not molecular host-cavity binding.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the detailed depletion mechanism here by using our prepared FONPs should be further figured out in the future work.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBTBT-4C8 FONPs
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source explicitly leaves detailed depletion photophysics unresolved.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not infer higher-state emission, triplets or a new switching mechanism from STED performance.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit flexible-chain restriction by lamellar packing is the source's explanation of enhanced aggregate performance, with dynamic evidence limited.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Packing and polymer compatibility enable restricted/less-quenching aggregated environments; no direct cavity inclusion.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The authors use TICT to explain initial solvent-polarity quenching, retained as a source assignment.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Measured yields/lifetimes and derived rates support a bounded balance comparison; lower knr only versus -2C8, not versus -0C8.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit flexible-chain restriction by lamellar packing is the source's explanation of enhanced aggregate performance, with dynamic evidence limited.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Packing and polymer compatibility enable restricted/less-quenching aggregated environments; no direct cavity inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The authors use TICT to explain initial solvent-polarity quenching, retained as a source assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Measured yields/lifetimes and derived rates support a bounded balance comparison; lower knr only versus -2C8, not versus -0C8.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
